about.bio:
I'm a Senior Software Engineer with a decade of experience building high-performance web and mobile applications across SaaS, E-Commerce, and EdTech. Currently at Northwind Labs, where I architect serverless systems on AWS.

My expertise spans the full stack — from crafting pixel-perfect React interfaces to designing cloud infrastructure with AWS CDK, Lambda, and DynamoDB. I've led teams, built design systems used across multiple products, and consistently delivered measurable performance improvements.

I use AI as a force multiplier — not a crutch. This portfolio starter ships with demo content you replace via the admin CMS.
